purpose: 建立可重用的台灣公司產能生命週期來源契約，跨半導體與鋼鐵驗證名目產能、實際產出、出貨、合格產能、高量產與稼動率不可混用。

cases.source: TSMC 2025 Annual Report / official fab-capacity page

capacity.evidence: Annual capacity of TSMC-managed manufacturing facilities exceeded 17 million 12-inch equivalent wafers.

actualThroughput.evidence: Total wafer shipments were 15.0 million 12-inch equivalent wafers in 2025.

lifecycleEvidence: later Arizona fabs remain installation/construction/future-HVM states
cases.falsification: Shipment throughput can differ from production because of inventory/WIP/product mix; ratio is not official fab utilization.

cases.source: CSC 2026 annual report and 2025-06-24 investor presentation

groupCapacityContext.scope: China Steel group, approximately; CSC ~9.9 + Dragon Steel ~6.0

lifecycleEvidence: Company states low-utilization and aged lines are being consolidated/sealed/retired.
No.1 blast furnace is planned to retire no later than 2029Q1.
Capacity optimization is an intentional supply response, not automatically a negative shock.
cases.falsification: A derived annualized quarterly proxy is not the company's reported utilization and cannot be compared numerically with TSMC shipment/capacity ratio as one common factor.

cases.source: GlobalWafers official location pages + U.S. Commerce award record
cases.falsification: Named facility, capital commitment and public subsidy do not identify current qualified/HVM capacity when the issuer page is stale.

crossIndustryConclusion: 同一生命週期契約可跨半導體與鋼鐵使用，但數值分母必須保留產品、單位與產能類型。
台積電與中鋼都能提供 issuer-native capacity + realized throughput/production evidence，解除『只有單一著名公司案例』阻塞。
環球晶證明來源過期或缺少實際產能時，正確輸出是 UNKNOWN，而不是用投資額或補助額代替。
跨產業只能比較生命週期狀態與資料品質，不能把不同產能比值直接做一個共同分數。
promotionReason: 已建立可重用、跨公司且跨半導體／鋼鐵的 issuer-native 產能來源契約；至少兩個產業可同時觀察名目產能與實際出貨/產量，且第三家公司保留缺失分母負向控制。這足以證明台股 PIT／可重播資料可行，但不代表稼動率因子有效。
reasonNoL4: 沒有前瞻/OOS產能狀態對營收、毛利、市占或股票報酬的驗證；官方稼動率、qualified/economic capacity 仍不完整，且不同產業分母不可直接數值合併。
exactNext: SC-053 前瞻追加下一個公司原生產能/產量/高量產版本，不回填 first-known 時鐘。
尋找至少一個官方揭露真正 utilization rate 的台灣 issuer/product 案例，驗證 derived proxy 與官方率差異。
建立延遲、取消、低稼動率或主動縮產的正式負向控制，再考慮任何 L4 outcome test。
